canonical_title: Maximum intensities in overlapping beams of forward and rear position lights.

versions.title_at_revision: Maximum intensities in overlapping beams of forward and rear position lights.
versions.text: No position light intensity may exceed the applicable values in the following table, except as provided in Sec. 27.1389(b)(3). Maximum intensity Overlaps Area A (candles) Area B (candles) Green in dihedral angle L ---------------------- 10 1 Red in dihedral angle R ------------------------ 10 1 Green in dihedral angle A --------------------- 5 1 Red in dihedral angle A ------------------------ 5 1 Rear white in dihedral angle L -------------- 5 1 Rear white in dihedral angle R ------------- 5 1 Where- (a) Area A includes all directions in the adjacent dihedral angle that pass through the light source and intersect the common boundary plane at more than 10 degrees but less than 20 degrees; and (b) Area B includes all directions in the adjacent dihedral angle that pass through the light source and intersect the common boundary plane at more than 20 degrees.
